question_en: Where can I see my current holdings?
question_zh: 在哪裏可以查看我目前的持倉？
answer_en: Open the Portfolio page from the side menu. It lists every fund you hold, with units, latest price and market value.
answer_zh: 從側邊選單打開「投資組合」頁面，即可查看您持有的每隻基金，包括單位數目、最新價格及市值。

question_en: How often is my portfolio value updated?
question_zh: 我的投資組合價值多久更新一次？
answer_en:
Values are updated once every business day, after each fund publishes its net asset value (NAV).
On weekends and public holidays you will see the last business day's value.
answer_zh:
每個營業日於各基金公佈資產淨值（NAV）後更新一次。
在週末及公眾假期，您會看到上一個營業日的價值。

question_en: Why does my portfolio value differ from my monthly report?
question_zh: 為甚麼我的投資組合價值與月結單上的不同？
answer_en: The monthly report shows values as of the last business day of the month, while the Portfolio page shows the latest available prices.
answer_zh: 月結單顯示的是該月最後一個營業日的價值，而「投資組合」頁面顯示的是最新可用價格。

question_en: Can I see my portfolio in a different currency?
question_zh: 可以用其他貨幣查看投資組合嗎？
answer_en: Yes. Use the currency selector at the top of the Portfolio page to switch between HKD, USD and your fund's base currency.
answer_zh: 可以。使用「投資組合」頁面頂部的貨幣選擇器，即可在港元、美元及基金的基本貨幣之間切換。

question_en: How do I raise an allotment request?
question_zh: 如何提交認購申請？
answer_en: Go to Requests → New Request, choose "Allotment", select the fund and enter the amount. Review the summary, then submit.
answer_zh: 前往「申請 → 新申請」，選擇「認購」，再選擇基金並輸入金額。核對摘要後提交即可。

question_en: How do I redeem part of my holding?
question_zh: 如何贖回部分持倉？
answer_en: Go to Requests → New Request and choose "Redemption". You can redeem by number of units or by amount.
answer_zh: 前往「申請 → 新申請」並選擇「贖回」。您可以按單位數目或按金額贖回。

question_en: What is the dealing cut-off time?
question_zh: 交易截止時間是甚麼時候？
answer_en: Requests received before 4:00 p.m. Hong Kong time on a dealing day are processed that day. Later requests are processed on the next dealing day.
answer_zh: 於交易日香港時間下午四時前收到的申請會在當日處理，之後收到的申請會在下一個交易日處理。

question_en: Can I cancel a request after submitting it?
question_zh: 提交申請後可以取消嗎？
answer_en: Yes, as long as its status is still "Pending". Open the request and tap Cancel Request.
answer_zh: 可以，只要申請狀態仍為「處理中」。打開該申請，然後按「取消申請」即可。

question_en: When will I receive my redemption proceeds?
question_zh: 何時會收到贖回款項？
answer_en:
Proceeds are usually paid to your registered bank account within 5 business days after the dealing day.
The exact timing depends on the fund's settlement cycle.
answer_zh:
款項一般會在交易日後五個營業日內存入您登記的銀行戶口。
實際時間視乎基金的結算週期。

question_en: Where can I download my monthly report?
question_zh: 在哪裏可以下載月結單？
answer_en: Go to Reports, choose the month, then tap Download. Reports are provided as PDF files.
answer_zh: 前往「報告」，選擇月份，然後按「下載」。報告以 PDF 格式提供。

question_en: When is the monthly report available?
question_zh: 月結單何時可供查閱？
answer_en: The report for each month is usually available by the 10th business day of the following month.
answer_zh: 每月的月結單一般會在下個月的第十個營業日前提供。

question_en: How far back can I access past reports?
question_zh: 可以查閱多久以前的報告？
answer_en: You can access reports from the past 7 years. For older reports, please message your Relationship Manager.
answer_zh: 您可以查閱過去七年的報告。如需更早的報告，請傳送訊息給您的客戶關係經理。

question_en: The PDF won't open. What should I do?
question_zh: PDF 無法打開，該怎麼辦？
answer_en: Make sure you have a PDF reader installed, then try downloading the file again. If it still won't open, message your Relationship Manager.
answer_zh: 請確認已安裝 PDF 閱讀器，然後重新下載檔案。如仍無法打開，請傳送訊息給您的客戶關係經理。

question_en: Why do I need to renew my KYC documents?
question_zh: 為甚麼需要更新 KYC 文件？
answer_en: Regulations require us to keep your identity and address records up to date. We will remind you before your documents expire.
answer_zh: 根據監管規定，我們須保持您的身份及地址紀錄為最新。文件到期前，我們會提醒您。

question_en: Which documents do I need to upload?
question_zh: 需要上載哪些文件？
answer_en: Usually a valid ID or passport and a proof of address issued within the last 3 months, such as a utility bill or bank statement.
answer_zh: 一般需要有效的身份證或護照，以及近三個月內發出的住址證明，例如水電費單或銀行月結單。

question_en: How do I upload my renewed documents?
question_zh: 如何上載更新後的文件？
answer_en: Go to Settings → KYC Documents, tap Upload next to the document, and choose a photo or PDF file.
answer_zh: 前往「設定 → KYC 文件」，在相關文件旁按「上載」，然後選擇相片或 PDF 檔案。

question_en: What happens if my KYC documents expire?
question_zh: 如果 KYC 文件過期會怎樣？
answer_en:
New allotment requests will be put on hold until your documents are renewed.
Your existing holdings are not affected.
answer_zh:
在您更新文件前，新的認購申請將會暫停處理。
您現有的持倉不受影響。

question_en: How do I message my Relationship Manager?
question_zh: 如何傳送訊息給客戶關係經理？
answer_en: Tap the chat button at the bottom right of any page, then choose "Talk to my RM".
answer_zh: 在任何頁面按右下角的對話按鈕，然後選擇「聯絡我的客戶關係經理」。

question_en: How quickly will my RM reply?
question_zh: 客戶關係經理多快會回覆？
answer_en: Your RM usually replies within one business day. You will get a notification when a new message arrives.
answer_zh: 客戶關係經理一般會在一個營業日內回覆。收到新訊息時，您會收到通知。

question_en: Can I send attachments in a message?
question_zh: 可以在訊息中附加檔案嗎？
answer_en: Yes. You can attach images and PDF files up to 10 MB each.
answer_zh: 可以。您可以附加圖片及 PDF 檔案，每個檔案上限為 10 MB。
